# sample.mkv

Synthetic, redistributable test clip (about 33 KB): 5 s, 160x90 H.264 video
(ffmpeg `testsrc`), stereo AAC audio (440 Hz sine), an ASS subtitle track
tagged `ara` (one short Arabic line, style font "Noto Naskh Arabic", no
embedded font) and an SRT track tagged `eng`.

Created with ffmpeg and mkvmerge (MKVToolNix v102):

```sh
# ara.ass: a minimal [Script Info] / [V4+ Styles] / [Events] file with one line:
#   Dialogue: 0,0:00:01.00,0:00:03.00,Default,,0,0,0,,مرحبا بالعالم
printf '1\n00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000\nHello world\n' > eng.srt

ffmpeg -v error -y -f lavfi -i testsrc=size=160x90:rate=10:duration=5 \
  -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=5 -ac 2 \
  -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 35 -pix_fmt yuv420p \
  -c:a aac -b:a 32k -ar 16000 base.mkv

mkvmerge -o sample.mkv base.mkv \
  --language 0:ara --track-name 0:Arabic ara.ass \
  --language 0:eng --track-name 0:English eng.srt
```

Resulting mkvmerge track ids: 0 video, 1 audio, 2 subtitles `ara`, 3 subtitles `eng`.

# speech_en_10s.opus

Synthetic English speech for the whisper.cpp transcription tests (about 13 KB,
10 s, mono 16 kHz Opus at 16 kb/s). Released under CC0 1.0: machine speech
generated by eSpeak NG from the sentence below, padded with silence to 10 s.

Created with eSpeak NG 1.52.0 and ffmpeg:

```sh
espeak-ng -v en-us -s 130 -w speech.wav \
  "This is a SubForge speech test. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."
ffmpeg -hide_banner -v error -y -i speech.wav -af apad=whole_dur=10 \
  -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a libopus -b:a 16k -map_metadata -1 -fflags +bitexact \
  speech_en_10s.opus
```

The tests that need a real model (`tests/whisper_transcribe.rs`) are ignored
unless `SUBFORGE_WHISPER_TEST=1`. They need the `tiny` model and the Silero VAD
model in a cache directory, read from `SUBFORGE_WHISPER_CACHE` (default: the
app's cache, `<user cache>/subforge/whisper-ggml`). Fill a cache once with the
app (the download button next to the model) or with
`subforge_core::whisper::download("tiny", cache, DEFAULT_BASE_URL, ..)`, then:

```sh
SUBFORGE_WHISPER_TEST=1 SUBFORGE_WHISPER_CACHE=/path/to/cache \
  cargo test --test whisper_transcribe -- --include-ignored
```
